heroTitle: Frames that hold a little longer than a glance.
heroSub: Originally from Bangladesh, now studying and shooting in Vienna — I make images out of streets, architecture, and the corners of Austria I find while I'm out there.
aboutP1: I'm Al Nafis Fuad Shuvo, an international student from Bangladesh, currently based in Vienna, Austria.
aboutP2: I'm pursuing an MSc in Digital Economy at WU Wien. Photography is what I do between lectures, commutes, and trips around the country.
aboutP3: Every photo below is tied to the place I took it — this page grows as I go.
